verdict.rationale: React clearly covers the modular half of the story: apps are built from encapsulated, self-managing components that compose into complex UIs (react-gh-1, react-docs-11), and data is passed into them as inputs (react-docs-24). Nothing in the evidence documents a dependency-injection mechanism, so the DI half rests only on the implied pattern of passing data down. Missing for 10: documented dependency-injection or provider mechanism, independent corroboration of DI-style app organization.
